manual_activity: The FAE identifies each OCP module and service path, resolves fatal command semantics, approves isolation and fatal policy, performs one injection under independent OOB control and owns platform plus interface recovery.

Physical OCP slot/module/serial/FW/driver/interface to endpoint/root-port BDF and service-dependency map
Distinct-coverage statement versus PCIe row 59 and independent management/recovery path
Decoded 7EF6030 plus AER masks, DPC and SyncFlood/reset policy

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Execute one topology-mapped fatal OCP ECRC stimulus with durable OOB capture and verify the approved reset branch through restored interface and service health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds module/service identity, authoritative severity, decoded policy, dependency isolation, durable timing, distinct OCP coverage and rollback.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Fatal OCP title and ECRC note conflict with both Correctable step labels, and errortype 2 lacks vendor proof. The same single BDF pair as PCIe row 59 cannot establish OCP slot 1~N or distinct coverage; module/service mapping is absent, 7EF6030 is undecoded, timeout undefined, RHEL 2022 ambiguous and DeepSeek includes copied memory wording.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review can preserve the fatal OCP ECRC intent and document unresolved execution authority. The record completes while injection remains gated.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 60 Wistron-System RAS-00780-V002: decide whether Correctable labels are defects and prove errortype=2 fatal ECRC semantics; provide physical OCP slot/module/serial/FW/driver/interface-to-endpoint/root-port BDF plus service mapping and distinct coverage versus PCIe row 59; decode/approve 7EF6030, masks, DPC/SyncFlood; define exact AER severity, reset/boot, link/interface/service recovery, supported OS, timeout, aborts, independent OOB path and restoration.

review_improvement: Adds OCP-specific identity, dependency and service recovery to the fatal ECRC oracle while preventing the contradictory command labels and copied PCIe BDFs from being treated as executable authority.
independent_technical_reasoning: A fatal error on an OCP NIC can remove the same path used for host control, so recovery evidence must arrive through an independent channel. Reusing the PCIe companion's BDFs does not demonstrate that any OCP module was targeted. Because a host reset can erase volatile OS logs, BMC/UEFI and console timestamps must bridge injection through reboot before interface and service health can be accepted.
